description: This file defines the Borders class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, responsible for managing border styles for spreadsheet cells, including individual borders, pseudo-borders, and border styling application methods.

classes.name: Borders
classes.description: Represents border styles for spreadsheet cells, supporting individual borders, composite styles (pseudo-borders), and style application from arrays. It can function as a supervisor managing multiple border components.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Borders object, managing various border components and pseudo-borders, with optional supervisor mode.

methods.name: getSharedComponent
methods.description: Returns the shared style component for the active cell in the currently active sheet.

methods.name: getStyleArray
methods.description: Builds an array structure representing the border style components from a provided array.

methods.name: applyFromArray
methods.description: Applies border styles to the borders object from an associative array, handling individual borders and pseudo-borders.

methods.name: getLeft
methods.description: Returns the Border object representing the left border.

methods.name: getRight
methods.description: Returns the Border object representing the right border.

methods.name: getTop
methods.description: Returns the Border object representing the top border.

methods.name: getBottom
methods.description: Returns the Border object representing the bottom border.

methods.name: getDiagonal
methods.description: Returns the Border object representing the diagonal border.

methods.name: getAllBorders
methods.description: Returns the pseudo-border representing all borders; only available for supervisor mode.

methods.name: getOutline
methods.description: Returns the pseudo-border representing the outline; only available for supervisor mode.

methods.name: getInside
methods.description: Returns the pseudo-border representing inside borders; only available for supervisor mode.

methods.name: getVertical
methods.description: Returns the pseudo-border representing vertical borders; only available for supervisor mode.

methods.name: getHorizontal
methods.description: Returns the pseudo-border representing horizontal borders; only available for supervisor mode.

methods.name: getDiagonalDirection
methods.description: Gets the diagonal direction for the border styles.

methods.name: setDiagonalDirection
methods.description: Sets the diagonal direction for the borders.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Returns a hash code representing the current border style.
